shots.name: Front Driver-Side 3/4
shots.instruction: Step 45° to the driver front corner. Align headlights, wheels, and front bumper.

shots.name: Straight Front
shots.instruction: Stand directly center-front. Center badge and align horizontal bumper guide.

shots.name: Front Passenger-Side 3/4
shots.instruction: Step 45° to passenger front corner. Balance hood length and side bodyline.

shots.name: Passenger-Side Full Profile
shots.instruction: Step back to center-passenger side. Ensure both wheels sit on the horizon guide.

shots.name: Rear Passenger-Side 3/4
shots.instruction: Position at rear passenger quarter. Frame taillight, trunk line, and rear wheel.

shots.name: Straight Rear
shots.instruction: Stand directly behind center bumper. Level license plate and rear window.

shots.name: Rear Driver-Side 3/4
shots.instruction: Position at rear driver corner. Align rear quarter panel and exhaust tips.

shots.name: Driver-Side Full Profile
shots.instruction: Step back to center-driver side. Frame both wheels flat along lower guideline.

shots.name: Front Driver Wheel & Tire
shots.instruction: Crouch at wheel center. Center wheel cap with brake caliper visible.

shots.name: Rear Passenger Wheel & Tire
shots.instruction: Crouch square with rear wheel. Show tire tread depth and wheel rim condition.

shots.name: Grille & Headlight Detail
shots.instruction: Close-up of front emblem, grille texture, and driver headlight assembly.

shots.name: Rear Badge & Model Trim Detail
shots.instruction: Close-up of vehicle badge, trim lettering, and rear taillight lens.

shots.name: Driver Cockpit & Door Open
shots.instruction: Open driver door. Frame driver seat bolsters, pedals, and steering wheel.

shots.name: Dashboard & Steering Wheel
shots.instruction: Sit in passenger or rear seat. Frame complete steering wheel, dash, and air vents.

shots.name: Instrument Cluster & Odometer
shots.instruction: Ignition on. Frame odometer mileage clearly without steering wheel glare.

shots.name: Front Seats & Center Armrest
shots.instruction: Shoot from back seat looking forward. Show both seat cushions and center console.

shots.name: Rear Passenger Seats
shots.instruction: Open rear door. Frame rear passenger bench, headrests, and legroom.

shots.name: Infotainment Screen & Shifter
shots.instruction: Display navigation/radio active. Frame screen, climate controls, and gear shift.

shots.name: Trunk / Cargo Space
shots.instruction: Trunk lid open. Capture cargo floor, spare tire compartment, or folding seats.

shots.name: Engine Compartment
shots.instruction: Hood propped open. Shoot clean engine bay showing fluid reservoirs and battery.

shots.name: VIN Plate & Door Sticker
shots.instruction: High clarity macro of driver door jamb federal safety / tire pressure sticker.

shots.name: Key Fobs & Owner Manuals
shots.instruction: Display keys, master fobs, books, or window sticker on clean console or seat.

shots.name: Condition & Imperfection Log
shots.instruction: Close-up of any noticeable scratches, dings, or wear for transparent disclosure.

shots.name: Dealership Specialty / Extra Feature
shots.instruction: Sunroof, bedliner, tow hitch, upgraded sound, or custom modifications.

shots.name: Third-Row Seating
shots.instruction: Open the rear access door or liftgate. Show all third-row seats, headrests, belts and available legroom.

shots.name: Roof & Sunroof
shots.instruction: From the cabin center, frame the complete roof opening, glass and shade. Show fitted controls.

shots.name: Door Trim & Controls
shots.instruction: Door open. Include trim, window switches, handle and speaker; show visible wear honestly.

shots.name: Steering Wheel
shots.instruction: Center the full wheel rim, spokes and controls. Keep the cluster legible in the background.

shots.name: Center Console
shots.instruction: Frame shifter, storage, cup holders and armrest from above without blocking the light.

shots.name: Hood Open — Context
shots.instruction: From the front corner show the open hood, secure support and whole engine aperture.

shots.name: Convertible Roof Raised
shots.instruction: Raise and latch the roof. Show the complete profile, seams, glass and roof condition.

shots.name: Driver seat
shots.instruction: Open the driver door. Include the complete cushion, backrest and controls.

shots.name: Infotainment display
shots.instruction: Keep the complete display readable and reduce reflections.

shots.name: Truck bed
shots.instruction: Lower the tailgate. Include the full bed, liner and wheel wells.
